'''Platform 13-009''' was a landing platform that was located in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. In about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents infiltrated the [[Cloud City Sabacc Tournament]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Silas Draver]], a competitor in the competition, suspected that they agents were somehow cheating, so he tipped off the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] that a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] deal was going to take place on Platform 13-009 at 02:00, then had one of his thugs send a message to the agents telling them to meet him at the platform at that [[Time/Legends|time]]. Both the Wing Guard and the Alderaanian agents traveled to the rendezvous point and the Wing Guard attempted to arrest the agents, believing them to be criminals.
